implementationDetails.audioStrategy: Phase 2 plays a bundled recorded sample library for Grand, Upright, and Electric; Clav/Digital/Misc and the labeled fallback are honest runtime synthesis. One deterministic render pipeline (src/audio/render.ts + src/audio/effects.ts + src/audio/dsp.ts) serves both the browser and tests: the Web Audio backend pre-renders each voice through the exact graph (layer source → Mod 1 → Mod 2 → Delay → Amp/EQ/Filter → Compressor → per-voice frames) and plays it through layer buses, a live convolver reverb, layer level gains, master gain, and a DynamicsCompressor limiter to one destination; the fake test backend runs the identical code offline. Reverb and Rotary run live in the browser so mixes stay correct; reverb always precedes rotary. Master Level rides the master gain with click-free ramps.
